title: The Harbor Remembers
intro: Every light you tended is part of the way home.
instructions: Start at star 1. Follow the drawn links and visit every star once, finishing at the marked last star. Undo or restart whenever you like. There is no timer.
accessible_label: Let the crew align The Harbor Remembers
accessible_description: Collect the same pattern and queue the same +20% production for ten minutes. This route uses one Focus charge, just like routing the constellation.
